get.summary: Polled by the header: the jobs indicator and the Review badge.
Every job, newest first, with place in queue, progress and failure reason.

post.summary: Upload an export file; its import runs as a job.

get.summary: Every import, newest first, with its job and counts per outcome.
The original file of an import (a CSV or a voting sheet PDF) as an attachment.
The row records of an import in line order, filtered by outcome or vote.
Counts per outcome for each vote the import touched.

post.summary: Upload a scanned voting sheet; its extraction runs as a job.

get.summary: Every extraction, newest first, with its status, job and issue counts; optionally one status only.
One extraction: the sheet as read, its counts against the printed totals and its issues.
The scanned voting sheet PDF of an extraction as an attachment.

post.summary: Correct rows, header fields or the printed totals; the sheet is checked again.

get.summary: What approving the sheet now would do, by the importer's own rules; nothing is written.

post.summary: Approve a checked sheet: it is imported by the CSV's own rules. Exactly one of two simultaneous decisions applies.
Reject a sheet waiting for review. Exactly one of two simultaneous decisions applies.

get.summary: The Review inbox: conflicts ordered by vote, then subject.
The decision pane: both values with their origins, the decision and losing attempts.

post.summary: Accept or reject a conflict. Exactly one of two simultaneous decisions applies.

get.summary: Search by assembly vote id or title, session, date range, or votes with no position.
The vote's timeline, newest first, paged by history id.
Votes with their stance and weight, votes without a position first.
Each reporting quarter's chain of publications, newest quarter first.
The known rule sets, the default first. Only the admin may create a snapshot under another.

post.summary: Resolve a selection: vote count, votes without a position, and warnings. Runs no job.
Create a snapshot; it is calculated as a job. Refused when its name is taken, no vote matches or a vote has no position.

get.summary: Each state's rank and score movement between two snapshots, read from what they stored.
One state's breakdown: every vote with its category and the exact value used.
What would differ if the snapshot were created now. A live read; no job, score or rank.

post.summary: Publish for a reporting quarter, or replace its publication with a reason.
